objective: Make one fresh, account-isolated Codex CLI /status observation for codex1 and codex2, without a model task, transaction, mutation, or raw-output persistence.

authorization.approval_reference: User-authorized terminal workaround when no authenticated browser connector/export exists; quota/status only.
scope: codex1: one literal /status command in its own approved account runtime
codex2: one literal /status command in its own approved account runtime
authorization.transport_rule: Use detached tmux first; direct terminal fallback is allowed once only when tmux setup fails before /status starts.
prohibited: model prompt, model task, tool task, or provider transaction
dashboard access, dashboard export, Organization Usage API, or browser access
retry or fallback after /status starts, or more than one invocation per alias
reading or persisting credentials, cookies, email, account-home paths, raw pane, or raw stdout/stderr
inferring concurrency when it is not explicitly displayed
using any command other than interactive codex followed by literal /status

concurrency_status.rule: Only explicit provider-displayed concurrency may be recorded.

transport_binding.capture_rule: capture-pane may return only sanitized remaining-limit/window/reset fields and parser metadata; raw content must not be persisted or reported.

receipt_binding_contract.failure_rule: Interactive, malformed, ambiguous, nonzero, auth-prompt, timeout, or binding failure is BLOCKED/NEEDS_HITL with quota and concurrency unknown.

stop_conditions: Stop before invocation on invalid/expired/mismatched lease, runtime config, exact command, ownership, or tmux setup.
Stop immediately after the first /status outcome for each alias.
Never retry, infer a unit or concurrency, inspect auth material, persist raw output, or run a model task.
Close only after each child returns provider-native ExecutionReceipt and typed WorkResult and Root A validates all bindings and hashes.

integrity.normalization_method: Remove integrity.normalized_decision_sha256, serialize recursively sorted compact JSON as UTF-8 without trailing newline, then SHA-256.

readiness_basis: READY is limited to two child-owned, one-shot, tmux-first interactive /status observations under separate account leases; any result is human-reviewable and any ambiguity remains blocked.
